profile.name: 高密度任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一种高密度高速任意波形发生器，可输出用户定义的模拟波形、脉冲序列和定时控制信号，并支持序列器、波形存储器与命令表控制。常用于量子控制实验、脉冲编排、同步时序和高速电子测量。
profile.description_en: This is a high-density, high-speed arbitrary waveform generator that outputs user-defined analog waveforms, pulse sequences, and timing signals, with support for sequencer control, waveform memory, and command tables. It is commonly used for quantum control experiments, pulse sequencing, synchronized timing, and high-speed electronic measurements.
